content.intro: M1: Introduction to Sustainable Energy System Transformation
content.title: Welcome to the Sustainable Energy Academy!

content.text:
The Sustainable Energy Academy is a training and knowledge-exchange mechanism developed by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) to support the transition to sustainable energy worldwide.

This lesson describes the Academy's Objectives, Target Learners, Core Content and Programme Strategy.

UNDP works with partners in developing countries to advance sustainable and low-carbon energy transition. This work is anchored by its Strategic Plan 2022-2025.

Energy – along with poverty and inequality, governance, resilience, environment, and gender equality – are among the six signature solutions of the Strategic Plan. Together, the signature solutions represent UNDP’s vision to accelerate progress on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

This chapter provides more details on UNDP's Sustainable Energy Academy initiative.

The Sustainable Energy Academy aims to create concrete impact on the ground by providing countries with tailor-made capacity building and a strong global community of experts and practitioners on energy as an enabler for development.

The Academy will connect energy for development 💬️ with nexus topics such as social protection and employment, policy and governance, climate change, energy security, gender equality, finance, technology and data, water management and food resilience.

Through this initiative, UNDP Sustainable Energy Hub seeks to contribute to the achievement of the 2022-2025 UNDP Strategic Plan’s moonshot to support 500 million people in accessing clean, sustainable, and affordable energy and to accelerate the energy transition.

content.intro: M1: Introduction to Sustainable Energy System Transformation
content.title: Objectives
Shape the narrative of energy as an enabler for development
content.body: The Energy Academy plays a crucial role in reshaping the narrative surrounding energy by highlighting its potential as a catalyst for sustainable development. By integrating energy with various sectors such as social protection, health, gender equality, governance, digital, finance and climate adaptation and mitigation, we aim to emphasize the transformative power of renewable energy solutions in addressing complex development challenges.

content.title: Position energy as an essential topic in development-centered discussions
content.body: Through the Sustainable Energy Academy, we aim to position energy at the forefront of development-centered discussions, particularly within the Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) framework. By raising awareness and promoting dialogue on the importance of sustainable energy, UNDP seeks to influence policy and decision-making processes at both national and international levels.

content.title: Prepare governments on energy solutions, trends, challenges, and opportunities
content.body: The Energy Academy aims to provide countries with the necessary knowledge, skills, and resources to effectively implement energy solutions. By equipping relevant stakeholders, including UNDP staff, local and national governments, civil society, with the expertise to advocate for sustainable energy solutions, they can more effectively influence policy formulation and promote the adoption of innovative approaches to energy planning and implementation.

content.title: Create an interactive platform for technical knowledge and expertise sharing
content.body: The Energy Academy aims to serve as a vibrant and collaborative platform for technical knowledge and expertise sharing among countries. Through interactive modules, live webinars, discussion forums, and resource libraries, policymakers, government officials, and stakeholders will have access to a wealth of information, best practices, and case studies. This collaborative environment aims to foster cross-learning, facilitate peer-to-peer exchanges, and strengthen countries’ collective capacity to address energy-related challenges.

content.intro: M1: Introduction to Sustainable Energy System Transformation
content.title: Target Audience

content.text: The Sustainable Energy Academy is specifically designed to support and empower countries in their pursuit of sustainable energy for development. The primary target audience of the Energy Academy includes:

content.title: UNDP Regional and Country Offices
content.body: The Sustainable Energy Academy serves as a center of excellence, equipping UNDP staff in Regional and Country Offices with the technical knowledge and best practices in the field of energy.

content.title: Policymakers and Government Officials
content.body: The Sustainable Energy Academy aims to inform and engage policymakers and government officials at national and subnational levels.

content.title: National and International Energy Networks
content.body: The Sustainable Energy Academy actively engages with national and international energy networks to expand its reach and influence.

content.title: Other Key Stakeholders
content.body: Recognizing the importance of comprehensive and inclusive stakeholder engagement, the Academy collaborates with a wide range of entities integral to the success of sustainable energy initiatives. This includes representatives from civil society organizations- notably youth and women's groups, private sector, financial institutions, academia, and research organizations. By fostering multi-stakeholder dialogues and partnerships, UNDP can promote collective action, knowledge sharing, and collaboration towards achieving sustainable energy goals.

content.text:
The Sustainable Energy Academy is not limited to technical experts; it actively engages young people and diverse demographics.

Recognizing the cross-cutting nature of energy issues, the Sustainable Energy Academy also aims to engage stakeholders from diverse sectors such as health, social policy and gender equality, climate change, digital and data, governance, and finance. By fostering interdisciplinary collaboration and knowledge exchange, we seek to address the complex interactions between energy and these interconnected sectors, ensuring a holistic and integrated approach to sustainable development.
